description: Authoritative GVariant serialization vectors generated with PyGObject/GLib. 'value' is a JSON-native logical value, 'text' is the canonical GLib GVariant text representation, and 'hex' is the serialized byte sequence in host (little-endian) order. 'text_parseable' is false only when GLib's own text printer emits a representation its parser rejects. Real OSTree objects under ostree-objects/ are raw object files: GVariant framing is host-endian, but OSTree stores fixed-width scalar payloads in big-endian order.
